goal: Deploy the official Medusa backend and native Admin as a standalone Hub development service, keeping all commerce and Hub billing flows separate.
approach: Build only backend/Admin from frozen upstream dependencies; validate independent runtime settings; configure Redis modules and persistent development uploads; run safe migrations without upstream demo seeds; start compiled backend under node.

review.first_pass: No commerce API or core changes; default seeds are explicitly skipped. Existing storefront and upstream lockfile untouched. Runtime secrets independent and minimum 32 characters.
review.fixed_finding: Explicitly preserve backend CLI bin PATH in compiled working directory. Use the actual telemetry variable MEDUSA_DISABLE_TELEMETRY.
review.second_pass: All authored source under 400 lines. Frozen packages unchanged. No Hub billing imports, credentials, transaction mapping or SSO added. Start and migration use the same compiled config; persistent static directory assigned to node before dropping privilege.

migration_tls_diagnosis.observed_by_parent: Private Railway PostgreSQL 17-alpine service has no TLS; initial migrations table creation succeeded, separate module migration SELECT 1 probe timed out.
migration_tls_diagnosis.root_cause: The shared PG loader uses ssl=false when driver options are absent. The modules SDK obtains fresh defaults for a non-localhostname and enables TLS for its dedicated migration lock connection.

source.behavior: Empty project driver options reach shared connection factory.
Factory SSL default is false unless specified.
Remote host without explicit disable mode obtains SSL defaults.
Creates independent one-connection migration lock pool from resolved defaults; probe at line38 times out after10000ms.

migration_tls_diagnosis.verification: Executed installed loadDatabaseConfig against synthetic railway.internal URL. Default yielded TLS; explicit sslmode=disable yielded ssl=false. No actual credentials or external network involved.
migration_tls_diagnosis.resolution: Parent sets standard sslmode=disable only on the new private Railway service DATABASE_URL. No source patch, global SSL disable, increased timeout or broader access required.
migration_tls_diagnosis.acceptance_gap: Parent must rerun isolated migration and verify deployed readiness; local reproduction verifies configuration selection only.
